title: Among non-carcinogenic molecules that contain at least one sodium atom, wha
question: Among non-carcinogenic molecules that contain at least one sodium atom, what is the average number of oxygen atoms per molecule?

prediction.sql: SELECT AVG(oxygen_count) FROM (SELECT m.XCL_010, COUNT(CASE WHEN a.XCL_003 = 'o' THEN 1 END) AS oxygen_count FROM molecule AS m INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.XCL_010 = a.XCL_002 WHERE m.XCL_011 = '-' AND m.XCL_010 IN (SELECT a2.XCL_002 FROM atom AS a2 WHERE a2.XCL_003 = 'na') GROUP BY m.XCL_010)

eligibility.predicate: molecule.XCL_010 IN (SELECT atom.XCL_002 FROM atom WHERE atom.XCL_003 = 'na')

measures.eligibility_application: Eligibility predicates are applied before grouping so only non-carcinogenic sodium-containing molecules contribute per-molecule oxygen counts.
measures.multiplicity_argument: The inner query groups by molecule.XCL_010, producing one oxygen_count row per eligible molecule; the outer AVG therefore averages molecules, not atom rows.

unresolved_choices.reason: Observed molecule.XCL_011 values are '+' and '-'; historical programs use '+' for positive/carcinogenic status.

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT AVG(oxygen_count)
FROM (
    SELECT a.XCL_002,
           SUM(CASE WHEN a.XCL_003 = 'o' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS oxygen_count
    FROM atom a
    JOIN molecule m ON a.XCL_002 = m.XCL_010
    WHERE m.XCL_011 = '-'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM atom a2
          WHERE a2.XCL_002 = a.XCL_002
            AND a2.XCL_003 = 'na'
      )
    GROUP BY a.XCL_002
)
